items.b: GEMFIELDS REVENUE REACHES $106.0M AS NET DEBT FALLS TO $44.2M
items.t: The reviewed interim report for the six months to 30 June carries revenue, EBITDA, net debt and net asset value, none of which the 25 September trading statement stated. EBITDA was $40.7m against a $4.9m loss a year earlier.

items.b: PALLADIUM READS $1,170.00, 3.39% UNDER THE 30 SEPTEMBER MARK
items.t: Gold, silver and platinum sit 0.54%, 0.39% and 0.23% under the same mark. Palladium's quoted spread is $40.00 against gold's $2.00, so its single printed number carries the widest uncertainty on the board.

items.b: PRAGNELL RING MAKES $475,000 AT HERITAGE, 90% ABOVE THE HIGH
items.t: The 22.09-carat fancy yellow Carat Capital priced at a $250,000 high estimate on 9 September sold on 28 September in Dallas. Four of the sale's top five lots beat their high estimates and one sold 6.25% below.
